newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds end down but off day's lows.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds end down but off day's lows.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Dutch bonds close weaker but pare opening losses as short positions unwound. Curve continues flattening as short end weakens, spread to Bunds narrows as guilders underperform. Clinton win in Tuesday's U.S. election priced into market.
* Jan 2006s 100.69/77 (-0.13), bid yield 5.89 pct, 13 basis points under April 2006 Bunds from -15 bp at Friday's close.
* Jan 2023s 110.46/66 (-0.25), yielding 6.64 pct, 20 bp under long Bunds from -22 bp.
* Spreads: 10/2 yrs 221 bp vs 226 bp, 10/5 yrs 92 bp vs 93 bp.
